thread:
alexa: quick postmortem follow-up from the recurring midnight pages. want explicit owners, short timelines, and one metric to validate each change so we don't get the same pattern next week.

alexa: distilled actions: 1) reduce fanout for high-cardinality redis errors & exclude low-impact hosts (owner: mohit), 2) adopt burst-aware dedupe window + static fallback (owner: yara), 3) add tiered paging policy + mute circuit-breaker (owner: alexa), 4) update runbook and dashboards (owner: alexa).

mohit: i'll take #1. plan: change grouping to region+shard and drop hosts that contribute <0.2% of errors over 1h. will test in staging and post delta in suppressed_pages.

yara: i'll own #2. proposal: "adaptive_dedupe: true" with rules: window = max(120s, 3*median_interarrival) bounded 120-600s; fallback static window 300s. canary in eu-prod 12h, auto-backout if pages increase.

yara: sample config i'll test in dev: `adaptive_dedupe: {min_s:120, max_s:600, static_fallback:300}`

alexa: for #3 I'll add paging tiers: critical -> page always, high -> notify then page if >2 occurrences in 20m, med/low -> ticket only. also circuit-breaker: if a rule pages >5 times in 30m, mute paging for 45m and create ticket. i'll own policy PR and runbook changes.

alerts-bot: created Jira ONCALL-2044: "postmortem follow-up - redis noise, dedupe, paging tiers" linked to pm doc https://docs.internal/pm/2026-07-01

mohit: timeline: staging prototype by EOD Tue (1898849999), canary Wed 09:00 UTC (1898853600). will post contribution histogram.

yara: timeline: feature branch by Tue, canary Wed 09:00 UTC alongside mohit, rollback if auto-backout triggers. will add metric `dedupe_adaptive_window_s` to dashboards.

alexa: i'll open paging-policy PR Wed afternoon and update runbook once canary shows suppressed_pages up & false_suppression_rate < 1.5%. target review by Fri.

mohit: small note - add alert `suppressed_pages_ratio > 10%` to catch over-suppression.

yara: agreed, will add `false_suppression_rate` panel as well.

ops-bot: /remind set to review ONCALL-2044 results on 1898936400

alexa: thanks all. if any blockers ping here or tag @alexa. will post TL;DR to pm doc after completion. :white_check_mark:
